## Summary
Clean, well-scoped data-layer PR that matches the work item spec precisely. Verified locally: `npm run test` (6/6 new tests pass, no regressions), `npm run typecheck`, and `npx eslint` on changed files all pass.

## Notes
- `buildChangelogFeed` correctly decouples from the registry singleton via `ChangelogSource`, matching `lib/agent-registry.ts` conventions.
- Date normalization, author fallback, and sort/tiebreak logic all match the acceptance criteria exactly, and are backed by tests for each behavior (empty updates, tiebreak, blank/missing author, ISO truncation, multi-agent ordering, id/title passthrough).
- No UI/nav/docs changes, correctly out of scope per the card.
- `listChangelogEntries()` is currently unused (expected — follow-up `/changelog` page story will consume it).

No issues found. LGTM.

## Summary
Blocking correctness bug: `listChangelogEntries()` drops the newest changelog entry via an unexplained `.slice(1)`, which deviates from both the PR description and the work item spec, and is not caught by any test.

## Code Issues

### Blocking
- **lib/changelog.ts:31** — `listChangelogEntries()` is implemented as `buildChangelogFeed(backlogAgents).slice(1)`, silently discarding the first (i.e. newest, given the newest-first sort) entry from the combined feed. Both the PR description ("`listChangelogEntries()` — real entry point, calls `buildChangelogFeed(backlogAgents)`") and the linked work item's acceptance criteria ("Export `listChangelogEntries(): ChangelogEntry[]` = `buildChangelogFeed(backlogAgents)`") specify no slicing at all. This is the function real consumers (the upcoming `/changelog` page) will call, so today it would render a feed that is always missing its most recent update. There is no test covering `listChangelogEntries()` at all — every test in `tests/changelog.test.ts` exercises `buildChangelogFeed` directly with fixtures, so this regression isn't caught by `npm run test`. Should be `return buildChangelogFeed(backlogAgents);`.

## Notes
- `buildChangelogFeed` itself (date truncation, author fallback, sort/tiebreak) matches the spec and is well covered by the new tests.
- Recommend adding at least one test that calls `listChangelogEntries()` against the real registry (even just asserting entry count / no unexpected loss) so a regression like this is caught in CI going forward.

## Summary
Clean, well-scoped data-layer PR. The previously-flagged blocking bug (`.slice(1)` dropping the newest entry in `listChangelogEntries()`) has been fixed in the current HEAD, and a regression test against the real registry was added. Implementation matches the PR description and work item acceptance criteria exactly.

## Verification
- Re-fetched the current diff for `lib/changelog.ts` directly from the PR: `listChangelogEntries()` now correctly returns `buildChangelogFeed(backlogAgents)` with no slicing.
- `tests/changelog.test.ts` now includes a `listChangelogEntries` describe block asserting the full entry count against the real `backlogAgents` registry and equality with `buildChangelogFeed(backlogAgents)` — this would catch a regression like the previous `.slice(1)` bug.
- CI (lint, typecheck, test, build) is green on current HEAD.
- Date normalization, author fallback, and sort/tiebreak logic all match spec and are covered by fixture-based tests (empty updates, same-date tiebreak, blank/missing author, ISO truncation, multi-agent ordering, id/title passthrough).
- No UI/nav/docs changes — correctly out of scope per the card.

No outstanding issues. LGTM.

## Summary
Clean, well-scoped, data-layer-only PR. Verified current HEAD (ea29a0c) directly against the repo — the implementation and tests match the work item spec exactly, and the previously-reported blocking bug (`.slice(1)` dropping the newest entry) is confirmed fixed with a regression test in place.

## Verification
- `lib/changelog.ts`: `listChangelogEntries()` returns `buildChangelogFeed(backlogAgents)` unmodified — no slicing, matches PR description and acceptance criteria.
- `buildChangelogFeed`: flattens `updates[]` via `flatMap`, truncates `date` to `YYYY-MM-DD` via `slice(0, 10)`, falls back to `"unknown"` via `author?.trim() || "unknown"`, sorts newest-first with `agentTitle` `localeCompare` tiebreak — all correct against `AgentUpdate`/`BacklogAgentManifest` types in `lib/backlog-meta.ts`.
- `ChangelogSource = Pick<BacklogAgentManifest, "id" | "title" | "updates">` correctly decouples the pure function from the registry singleton, enabling fixture-based tests.
- `tests/changelog.test.ts` covers every acceptance-criteria behavior: zero entries for no-updates agent, same-date tiebreak by title, blank/missing author fallback, newest-first ordering (same-agent and 3+ agents), ISO timestamp truncation, id/title passthrough, and a dedicated `listChangelogEntries` test against the real registry that would catch a regression of the earlier `.slice(1)` bug.
- CI (lint, typecheck, test, build) is green on current HEAD.
- No UI/nav/docs changes — correctly out of scope per the linked work item.

No outstanding issues found.
